title: Cade Mower Wins His Battle on The Voice and Moves On
summary:
Cade Mower is singing on The Voice. On October 26, the 35-year-old singer from Bluffdale, Utah, won his Battle round. He sang Wondering Why by the Red Clay Strays with Brayden Howell, 19, another singer on Team Riley.

Mower first made all four coaches turn their chairs in the Blind Auditions with Zach Bryan's Something in the Orange. Coach Riley Green put Mower and Howell together for the Battle, and Carly Pearce helped Team Riley as a guest adviser.

Before the show, Mower talked about how hard it is to be away from his wife, Lindsey, and their two children while filming. He said winning the Battle would bring him one step closer to making the sacrifice worth it, and he called his wife his biggest fan.

Afterward, Kelly Clarkson praised his voice, calling his vocals insane. Queen Latifah said she wished Mower had joined her team, and she also praised Howell. Green picked Mower to move on, saying Mower already knows what he does well. Mower now goes into Cut Week as one of seven left on Team Riley.
why_it_matters: It shows how practice and knowing your strengths can help you do your best when you perform for others.
